heading: multiview MH-4 — `🧊️catalog-silhouette`: the small-hole rule turns a corrected drawing red
text: The repair proposed by MX at 11:41 is written and measured: `agreedPockets` (one decision per cell for the drawn and the body mask: an enclosed hole of at most the limit is filled in both when the other mask covers the cell or has such a hole there too; where the other mask is open it stays outline in both) and `Mask.sealRings` (the hairline closing of the seal for drawn rings). Trial copy `🧰️matrix/MX-2/pocket/silhouette.ts`, failing-first cases `pocket/test.ts` (green 9 of 9 on the trial copy, 6 of 9 on the live module: the slit of your thigh at 1:500 gives 27 cells against 5, the hole at the limit 21 against 1, the hairline of a fifth of a cell 10 differing cells). `measure.ts` on 17 catalog assets, every authored scale and view in the default pose: 0 views change sides at the gate of `🧊️catalog-silhouette` (fail to pass 0, pass to fail 0); the measured distance moves in the direction you described, e.g. `miscanthus-grass` 1:50 plan 13.3 mm to 3.8 mm. NOT landed: it decides all 385 assets, and at 19:55 fixer chains of 10 batches still run and 2 documents changed in the last ten minutes (about 300 in the last 45); it is landed when the catalog is quiet, with the whole `🧊️catalog-silhouette` suite before and after (see the report, section "Pocket rule"). Until then keep the thigh as it is.
